requirements.title: Database Design
requirements.literal_acceptance:
# 162. DATABASE DESIGN

Use a proper relational model.

Likely tables include:

```text
users
career_profiles
career_facts
work_experience
education
certifications
skills
projects
answer_bank

search_profiles
search_queries
search_filters

companies
company_aliases
company_domains
company_relationships

job_sources
company_job_sources
source_runs
company_discovery_runs
company_discovery_evidence
ats_providers
ats_tenants

canonical_jobs
job_postings
job_posting_versions
application_routes

job_skills
job_requirements
job_locations

job_match_scores
job_match_components

documents
resume_versions
cover_letter_versions

application_rules
applications
application_attempts
application_answers
application_documents
application_events

browser_profiles

operations
audit_logs
notifications
settings
```

Exact names may differ.

---
requirements.interpretation_boundary: The original requirement calls for a proper relational model and explicitly presents likely table names, permitting different names. Acceptance here would establish relational design, not all illustrative product features, a multi-user account system, or MJ-REQ-174 ORM/security acceptance. Typed immutable JSON attributes do not replace the relational ownership and integrity model.

criterion_mapping.representation: career_profiles, profile_versions and FK-linked career_facts; typed/versioned facts and reviewed answers/contact JSON preserve immutable snapshots.

FK-linked search_profiles, companies, company_aliases, company_domains, company_ats_tenants, company_job_sources and company_discovery_requests; validated structured criteria and monitoring policy fields.

canonical_jobs -> companies; job_postings -> canonical_jobs; posting_snapshots -> job_postings; application_routes -> jobs/companies; job_matches -> jobs/profiles with bounded score and profile-version context.

applications -> job/route/profile, unique job/profile and state check; application_attempts, application_route_choices and documents link through foreign keys; uploaded_resumes, resume_revisions and resume_workspace_revisions retain versioned artifacts.
worker_operations retain state/progress/cancellation/retry/lease metadata; profile-owned AI/provider/policy tables have relational ownership and constraints; audit_events retain durable history.

Alembic revisions migrate existing databases; cli.migration_precondition compares required and observed columns, primary keys and validated foreign keys before runtime provisioning. SQLite setup is test-only; production uses PostgreSQL/Alembic.

Verify candidate schema on fresh migrated disposable PostgreSQL and read-only deployed schema; preserve skips separately.

requirements.title: Configuration
requirements.literal_acceptance:
# 275. CONFIGURATION

Do not require source-code editing for ordinary settings.

UI/environment configuration should cover:

```text
AI
sources
source intervals
company discovery
match thresholds
application rules
application limits
browser profiles
documents
notifications
logging
```

---

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: AI Settings UI; profile-scoped /profiles/{profile_id}/ai-task-settings API; provider environment settings.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Saving provider/model choices persists across Store reopen, remains profile-scoped, rejects credential-shaped settings, and all-disabled still permits deterministic matching and factual documents. This does not claim live paid-provider acceptance.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: Supported source configuration and enable/disable controls; persisted source/search-profile settings.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Saved source enablement, typed capabilities and policy control actual collection/scheduling; disabled and failed sources do not incorrectly block independent sources.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: Source poll interval, request timeout, rate, jitter and saved-search scheduling settings.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Saved cadence survives reopen and changes due scheduling, including deduplication and source-isolated failure/backoff behavior.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: Profile company-discovery enabled flag, minimum/priority score thresholds and hourly discovery cap; company monitoring controls.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Explicit profile preferences prevent disabled discovery, control request priority and hourly admission, and retain configured dispatch priority after review.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: AI cost controls and profile-scoped eligibility minimum; selected-search scoring preferences.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Saved thresholds and candidate caps change eligible preview/document-preparation candidates, persist by profile, and are effective without making provider calls.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: Profile route preference and explicit route choice; reviewed sensitive-answer/confidence policies.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Stored application preferences survive reopen, enforce review for sensitive answers, and USER_CHOICE requires an explicit route before preparation. External submission remains disabled.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: MJOBS_SUBMISSION_HOURLY_LIMIT, MJOBS_SUBMISSION_DAILY_LIMIT and MJOBS_SUBMISSION_COMPANY_LIMIT; safe /settings readback.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Actual durable admission enforces zero and positive hourly/daily/company caps, serializes competing admissions, survives reopen and cannot enable real-employer submission.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: MJOBS_BROWSER_PROFILE validated nonsecret label; immutable per-application browser-profile-selection.json manifest; /settings readback.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Real controlled Chromium launch uses the configured application-isolated profile; later auth resolution remains pinned after environment changes. Legacy sessions retain their path, Windows reserved names and aliases are rejected, and malformed/special-file manifests fail closed. Supported live-provider sessions are not established by this fixture.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: Document preparation UI options for cover-letter style/length, resume tailoring/contact/skill order/page target and reviewed facts.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Changing document options creates distinct, reviewable durable versions and visible output changes while retaining prior document bytes and fact provenance; bad stored bytes block download.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: MJOBS_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=0/1; in-app mute/dismiss controls; bounded profile-scoped read-only refresh.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Disabled mode renders no notifications; enabled mode observes a newly completed stored operation without user refresh, supports dismissal/mute, isolates profile readback and contains no private error text. No email, webhook or external notification delivery is implied.

configuration_categories.configuration_surface: MJOBS_WORKER_LOG_LEVEL environment setting, forwarded through Compose; structured audit logging remains independent.
configuration_categories.behavior_to_verify: Worker startup passes the normalized setting to RQ, rejects invalid levels before startup effects, preserves the existing default, and the backup validator accepts exactly the same supported levels.

requirements.scope_boundary: Ordinary supported configuration is available through UI/API/environment without source editing. Browser selection is application-isolated and verified with the controlled fixture; unsupported live-provider sessions, paid AI execution, full future notification delivery and real employer submission are not claimed.

partial_progress.title: Bound External Operations
partial_progress.literal_acceptance:
# 4. BOUND EXTERNAL OPERATIONS

Every operation that may hang should use:

```text
timeouts
captured output
controlled cancellation
retry policy
error classification
```

This includes:

```text
HTTP requests
browser navigation
browser selectors
AI requests
document parsing
OCR
external processes
source collectors
ATS collectors
```

Never leave workers permanently blocked on one source.

---
partial_progress.implemented_slice: Diagnostic native DOM collection shares a finite total deadline across CDP phases, cancels stalled protocol work, bounds browser-side traversal/output before Python decode, omits DOM on unsupported or invalid paths, and preserves the original operation failure. Selection-manifest reads reject special files rather than blocking on a FIFO.
remaining_criteria: The full original operation inventory is not globally bounded and accepted.
Filesystem operations and the entire CDP/driver transport have not been proven globally time-bounded under all host/protocol failures.
This diagnostic slice does not establish every HTTP/browser/AI/parser/OCR/process/source/ATS retry, cancellation and classification path.
